habitat: Mature evergreen and mixed broadleaf forest, forest edge and well-wooded hills, mid- to upper canopy; 200–2600 m
description: Deep maroon oriole with black head, neck and wings, bluish bill and yellow iris (female greyish-white below with black streaks); mid- to upper canopy of mature evergreen and mixed broadleaf forest (200–2600 m), eating wild figs, berries, insects and nectar.
